title: KDA two-step bottleneck screen
description: Machine-readable record of the six-layer screen and the selected deep dive described in docs/bottleneck-localization.md. KernelPilot validates this structure when analysis.bottleneck_screen is auto or required. Structural validity is not diagnostic validity: no validator can decide whether the cited evidence is sufficient or whether an attribution is overreaching.

task.description: Optional free-form task identifier for the reader.

layers.description: One entry per analysis viewpoint. Exactly the six ids below, each once. The six layers are perspectives, not six mandatory device experiments: a layer may be marked not_applicable or its evidence recorded as insufficient.

evidence.description: What is actually known now, with the file, command or artifact it came from. Not a plan.

continue.description: Whether this layer is worth a deeper experiment now.

key_unknown.description: The single most decision-relevant unknown for this layer. State 'none' only when the layer is not_applicable.

decision_supported.description: What the next experiment in this layer would let the run decide, and what it would not.

deep_dives.description: Selected diagnoses. At least one entry is required whenever any layer reports continue=yes.

hypothesis.description: One falsifiable statement about the current bottleneck.

control.description: The variables held fixed, and the comparison that isolates the changed variable.

expected_change.description: The observable that should move, in which stage, and roughly by how much.

next_action.description: What the run does after a supporting result and after a refuting one.

stop.description: The budget and the condition that ends this line of investigation.

change_class.description: Which class of change the current candidate belongs to. Used to keep a kernel rewrite from being reported as a compiler change and a configuration switch from being reported as a source change.

evidence_chain.description: Optional four-link record: source, compiled artifact, actual execution, performance change. Each link names what it proves and what it does not.

attribution.description: Optional record of two separate axes: how well the comparison was controlled, and how deep the observation went. Neither implies the other, so a counter reading is not recorded as a stronger level than a controlled A/B.

control_level.description: L0 correlation, L1 single-variable A/B, L2 A/B plus a fixed-config control, L3 L2 plus an artifact observation matching the predicted mechanism.

observation.description: How deep the evidence reaches. Recorded separately from control_level.

scope_note.description: Required when observation is counter: the counter's documented scope, and what the reading does not cover.

decomposition.description: Optional three-number record for a gain with more than one source. Subtracting one number from another is not a decomposition: source, configuration and code generation can interact.

source_at_fixed_config.description: The semantic delta measured against the same source at a pinned configuration.

config_at_fixed_source.description: The configuration delta measured at fixed source.

relationship.description: Whether the two deltas add up to the deployed result. 'unknown' is a valid answer and is the honest default.

not_pursued.description: Directions deliberately dropped, with the reason. Keeps a later reader from re-running a decision that was already made.
